original_test_intent: Back up the original GPU FRU, program the exact approved FRU image into the intended device, and prove persistent byte/field equivalence and healthy inventory after the write.
original_method: Verify signed AGT and stable GPU/I2C/BMC mapping, securely read and hash complete original FRU, validate approved image schema/size/checksums/identity, perform one target-bound flash, read back through independent AGT/IPMI paths after required persistence boundary, compare bytes and decoded fields, and retain rollback.
manual_activity: Manufacturing/GPU owner approves target and FRU image/content, validates backup/restore and secure BMC path, supervises one flash and sets verdict.
required_inputs: Complete original FRU backup and proven restore method
Secure BMC credentials, stable power, persistence/OOB/recovery plan
safety_requirements: Verify target and image compatibility twice
One write only under stable power; no retry
Post-read through independent paths, verify checksums/persistence and recover on any mismatch
agent_execution_scope: Perform secure pre-read and preserve backup
Execute one authorized flash and complete post-read comparison
Report without choosing image/credentials/target or verdict
engineer_actions: Authorize permanent write and secure access

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Generic syntax is not the source AGT mode and omits raw IPMI before/after, target semantics and security controls.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Using verified `4,100,0,9` semantics and brokered BMC access, back up full FRU, flash the exact approved file once, then independently read/compare all bytes and decoded fields.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: I2C tuple/mode, read-before/write/read-after sequence and FRU-file comparison are retained; literal secrets/IP are not.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a signed flash manifest binding target, original FRU hash, approved file hash/decoded fields and exact commands, followed by byte/field/checksum/persistence comparisons.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds secure credentials, complete backup/restore and precise file/target integrity.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Read-only FRU display or serial-field write cannot substitute for full FRU image programming.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Raw read length 128 may not cover the complete FRU unless vendor/platform confirms region extent.

project_override_considerations: Manufacturing owner defines FRU region extent/schema, authoritative contents and whether the original image is safely restorable.
expected_evidence: Immediate and post-reset raw readback with byte/field/checksum diff
BMC/AGT inventory/audit/log health, credential cleanup, recovery disposition and verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master coherently defines pre-read/flash/post-read; unsafe literal access data and placeholder file are execution defects, not intent conflicts.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Tool, file, target, credentials and recovery inputs can be supplied.

review_improvement: Makes full FRU programming a secure, target-bound, backed-up, byte-and-field verified transaction rather than a generic flash call.
independent_technical_reasoning: Decoded fields can look correct even if checksums, padding or another FRU area is corrupted, while a fixed 128-byte raw read may omit data. Acceptance needs the platform-confirmed full region plus byte and decoded-field comparisons. Independent read paths reduce the chance that AGT's own cache masks a failed write; original bytes must be recoverable before mutation.
